title: Bound on one search round
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be finite binary words with $|s|\le |w|+1$. The word obtained by appending a $1$ to $s$ when $|s|\le |w|$, and otherwise leaving $s$ unchanged, has length at most $|w|+1$.
replaced: For all words $w$ and $s$ with $|s| \le |w| + 1$, the state produced by one search round still has length at most $|w| + 1$.
